text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Do you all remember? That there once was
an Umamusume named Matikanefukukitaru...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A peerlessly greedy girl with zero talent,
trying to rise to the top on sheer luck alone.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Yet, she went on to conquer the Arima Kinen.
Yes—at the cost of everything else."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: That girl became a god. Transcendental beyond horsekind, into the realm of the divine. And into the white light—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, please hold on! I'm
alive! In fact, I'm even more energized than before!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Full of pep is my main selling point, so don't go putting me to rest! Max happiness, Grand Prix peace!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I did it!
Are you happy? Are you glad you trained me?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, that's what I wanted to hear!
Alright, let's ride this momentum straight into the winner's interview!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Uhm, everyone across the nation, I've gone and made this celebratory day even more auspicious!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Today, standing here, I simply have to proclaim it:
'Following the Chrysanthemum stage, fortune has blessed Nakayama as well!'"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Good fortune comes to those who wish for it.
Happiness will always find its way if you pray for it."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well then, have a Happy New Year, everyone!
Next year, by bringing happiness to all of you,
I will find happiness too!
